verdict.rationale: The evidence shows inbound HTTP/Webhook triggers, where Pipedream receives webhooks to start workflows. It also shows event consumption via the REST API or a real-time SSE stream. Neither is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback that a consumer can subscribe to. The REST API's mention of 'handle subscriptions' is too vague to establish outbound webhook delivery, so the support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
